# Exergy

> Exergy (Denver, CO) works with building owners, hardware makers, and operators so energy a building already pays for can do useful work. Hydronic or forced air. The feasibility check is free. Exergy does not sell hardware.

## Pages

- [Home](https://exergyheat.com/): the field report, what we do, the Denver office, and how a project works
- [Commercial](https://exergyheat.com/commercial): heat a building with machines that pay their way
- [Partners](https://exergyheat.com/partners): bring hardware into buildings that need heat
- [Operations](https://exergyheat.com/operations): run a system after it is in
- [About](https://exergyheat.com/about): engineers who hate waste
- [Contact](https://exergyheat.com/contact): a free feasibility check, or a 15 minute call
- [Privacy policy](https://exergyheat.com/privacy-policy)
